I am old and my land is small, only this little plot behind my compound. I cannot buy expensive chemicals from the market, but I have goat and chicken manure from our animals that I will spread on the soil before planting. My children and grandchildren will help me clear the land and pull the weeds by hand when the rains come, and we will plant the cassava cuttings I kept from last season’s harvest.
